g_policy.reason: The offer copy states the reward is one day of premium before the user chooses to play. The decline and ad-failure fields leave the app unchanged.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 24 hours of in-app premium access, not cash or a transferable item.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is opening the app; it does not require chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal says it removes nothing free, and premium turning off after the rewarded day does not remove an existing free benefit.

g_brand_safety.reason: The placement is a card on s01 Chats home, which the product model rates safe, rather than an offer inside a conversation.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This is an existing-anchor idea, and m01 shows that the app charges for the Luzia+ subscription the reward samples.

c2_evidence.reason: Although the proposal cites no evidence, m01 supports the paid premium offering and s01 supports the named home screen. The proposal does not assert an unobserved free-tier limit.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is limited to 24 hours, so each grant is a time-limited sample of the subscription.

c5_moment.reason: The trigger places a card on s01 when the user opens the app; it does not interrupt an in-progress chat task.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The flow offers a sponsored game after an app-open event and grants premium after play; the ad-failure field says an uncounted game grants nothing.

c7_specific.reason: The proposal names s01 Chats home as its trigger screen and placement, although its explanation of why the idea fits is generic.

other_concern: A renewable 24-hour reward offered once per day could let users maintain premium access continuously by playing daily.
